args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Error toasts should use an assertive live region (e.g. a separate aria-live="assertive" region or role="alert" for error kind) and the auto-dismiss timeout in the Toast component should be skipped for item.kind === "error" so errors persist until the user dismisses them.

label: bug
file: src/components/Toast.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.
Toast.tsx renders all toasts inside a single `<div role="status" aria-live="polite">` container, and the Toast subcomponent unconditionally starts a setTimeout(AUTO_DISMISS_MS=5000) that calls onDismiss for every toast kind, including "error".
